facts.claim: The timber Chapel Bridge crosses the Reuss past the Water Tower between the theatre side and St Peter’s Chapel on Rathausquai.
facts.sourceLocation: Opening description: links the Lucerne Theatre on the south bank of the River Reuss with St. Peter’s Chapel on Rathausquai, passing the Water Tower.

facts.claim: Much of the bridge burned in August 1993 and the rebuilt bridge reopened in April 1994.
facts.sourceLocation: Disaster strikes: fire in the night of 18 August 1993; reopened on 14 April 1994.

facts.claim: The bridge’s pictorial decoration was developed under Renward Cysat; many panels suffered in the fire.
facts.sourceLocation: No bridge without pictures, no pictures without the bridge.
